purpose: E2 feature configuration, E3 candidate family, E4 walk-forward protocol and S2 decision rule. Frozen before any learned model is fitted to the causal dataset.

E2_historical_state.eligibility: an observation may enter the history used at refresh t_refresh only if t_close <= t_refresh
E2_historical_state.missing_history_behaviour: feature set to 0.0 and a companion history_valid flag set to 0; the observation is still usable by M0-M2
E2_historical_state.normalization: z-score with mean and standard deviation computed on the TRAIN fold only, then frozen for validation and deployment
E2_historical_state.reset_behaviour: history is per satellite and never crosses satellites; it accumulates continuously and is reset only if more than 30 days pass with no closed label (loss of continuity)
forbidden: the current deployment episode's reference element

E3_candidate_family.M1: age-only linear: r ~ a + b * age_tx
E3_candidate_family.M2: causal static ridge on the 9 deployable static features
E3_candidate_family.M3: last-closed-residual bias (constant, = median residual of the most recent closed episode)
E3_candidate_family.M4: EWMA residual bias (constant, alpha = 0.05 and 0.2, the better on validation)
E3_candidate_family.M5: recursive least squares bias/drift on [1, age_h], forgetting factor 0.99
E3_candidate_family.M6: two-state Kalman bias/drift tracker on episode-mean residual
E3_candidate_family.M7: ridge on the 9 static + 17 historical-state features
E3_candidate_family.constant_predictor_note: M3 and M4 are constants. They are gate-eligible here because a constant offset provisioned at refresh IS a deployable corrector. If a constant wins, that is reported as 'the learnable structure is an offset, not a function of features' and NOT as feature-based residual learning.
E3_candidate_family.kalman_R_rule: sample variance of the TRAIN-fold episode-mean residuals
forbidden_models: any model or feature chosen after inspecting deployment results

E4_walk_forward.scope: one model per satellite, fitted on all causally populated bands pooled, with age_tx as a feature. This matches deployment: an endpoint is provisioned with one corrector, not six.
E4_walk_forward.band_role: bands are a reporting stratification and a secondary diagnostic, not separate fits
E4_walk_forward.validation_placement: the chronologically LAST 25 percent of closed history immediately preceding the decision point
E4_walk_forward.selection_rule: m_star = argmin validation MAE over the gate-eligible candidates
E4_walk_forward.gate: G = 1 if MAE_{m_star}(validation) < gamma * MAE_SGP4(validation), else 0
E4_walk_forward.inference_scope_assertion: the deployment predictor receives no reference element, no reference epoch, no reference publication time and no label; enforced mechanically

S2_analysis.statistical_unit: the refresh EPISODE. The 24 transmissions inside one episode share one frozen stale element and usually one reference element, so they are not independent.
S2_analysis.aggregation: equal weight per satellite. Within a satellite, the effect is the mean over its deployment episodes of (MAE_learned - MAE_SGP4). Across satellites, the aggregate is the unweighted mean of satellite-level effects, so a high-count object cannot dominate by sample volume.
S2_analysis.uncertainty: hierarchical block bootstrap, 10000 resamples: resample satellites with replacement, then resample whole deployment episodes with replacement within each selected satellite. Report the 95 percent percentile interval of the satellite-balanced aggregate.
S2_analysis.cell_level_status: secondary diagnostic only; a single positive cell is not evidence

S2_pass_criteria_all_required.2_interval: hierarchical block bootstrap 95 percent interval excludes zero on the improvement side
S2_pass_criteria_all_required.3_breadth: improvement present in more than one satellite AND more than one orbital regime
S2_pass_criteria_all_required.4_no_domination: no single satellite contributes more than 50 percent of the aggregate gain
S2_pass_criteria_all_required.5_sign_stability: the sign is stable across adjacent walk-forward decision points
S2_pass_criteria_all_required.6_screen_robustness: the result does not depend on one screening threshold; re-evaluated at reject_hz in {750, 1000, 1500, 2500, no screen}
S2_pass_criteria_all_required.7_admission_safety: harmful-admission rate <= 0.20, where a harmful admission is a deployment segment with G = 1 whose realised MAE is worse than SGP4
S2_pass_criteria_all_required.insufficient_admissions_rule: if fewer than 10 admitted deployment segments exist, admission value is reported UNRESOLVED, not successful
explicit_non_passes: aggregate improvement driven by ISS sample volume
improvement visible only after deleting many observations

decision_after_E4.if_fail: STOP THIS PAPER LINE. Do not rewrite the manuscript as a leak-diagnosis or negative-result paper. Do not build E5 or E6. Archive code, manifests and results as an internal research audit.
decision_after_E4.if_pass: freeze the pilot result, obtain independent statistics and satellite/NTN review, then request human approval for E5. E6 remains unauthorized until E5 passes.
